ocr._not: Taranmis PDF ve fotograflanan belgeleri (fatura/makbuz) okumak icin: 'pip install pdf2image pytesseract'. Windows'a ayrica Poppler (https://github.com/oschwartz10612/poppler-windows/releases) ve Tesseract-OCR (https://github.com/UB-Mannheim/tesseract/wiki, kurulumda Turkce dil paketini de secin) kurulmali. PATH'e eklemediyseniz poppler_path / tesseract_cmd alanlarina tam yolu yazin (ornek: 'C:\\Program Files\\Tesseract-OCR\\tesseract.exe'). Kutuphaneler/motor kurulu degilse Kaizen cokmez, acik bir kurulum notu doner.
